title: Take a Walk
coreMove: Moving stillness uses rhythm to settle the body: walk with one narrow question, let step follow step, and decide after the mind stops gripping the problem.

exampleSpecs.stakes: show dynamic stillness inside a hard apology
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Emile lets the path pace the apology draft

exampleSpecs.audience: people planning rhythm before noise rises
exampleSpecs.stakes: lower cognitive load before movement becomes scramble

exampleSpecs.audience: people who need a short body reset without abandoning duty
exampleSpecs.stakes: separate the real report from the fear that followed

exampleSpecs.audience: people who freeze and call it discipline
exampleSpecs.stakes: show movement turning a message back into rhythm

exampleSpecs.stakes: show a repeated path reducing mistakes
